info.name: Blood Donation Platform
info.description: Single-file production collection: import this JSON only; no environment is required. Open collection Variables, set your private demoPassword and role emails, then run the login requests. baseUrl is https://b7a6-iota.vercel.app. Login saves role-specific and active access tokens in collection variables; protected requests automatically send the appropriate Bearer token. Postman captures and rotates the refreshToken cookie; keep the cookie jar enabled. Refresh updates the most recent login role. Run Session cleanup / Logout last to revoke the current cookie session and clear saved authorization. Collection values override stale environment variables. Alternative/provider requests remain opt-in. Passwords and tokens are blank in this submission file. Never submit a later export containing credentials.

item.name: Start Google login or authenticated linking

request.description: Manual, skipped by default. For first-time linking: sign in with email/password as the intended real Google-email owner, set the private googleLinkAccessToken collection variable, enable this request's Authorization header, set runGoogleOAuthRequests=true, and disable automatic redirects. The 302 Location and signed cookie bind this user to state/PKCE. Keep the cookie in this Postman jar, complete consent in a browser, and copy the unused code/state from the callback URL for the callback request. The browser callback returns 401 if it lacks this jar's cookie; it does not redeem the code. If a same-cookie browser client already redeemed it successfully, do not replay. Public Google login leaves the header disabled and succeeds only for an already linked provider account. No .local seed email can be used as a real Google email. Never forward the local Bearer header to Google.

Manual, skipped by default. Set googleAuthorizationCode/googleState from the real unused callback URL and run within ten minutes with the signed cookie from the start request in the same Postman jar. First-time linking requires that the start carried a valid Bearer token and that its current active user email matches Google's verified email. Public first-time linking returns 409 with sign-in instructions; already linked Google accounts may log in publicly. Cross-user links return 409. Each callback code is single-use. Successful login also updates the collection tokens and active session role automatically.

item.name: Session cleanup
item.description: Run after workflows. Logout clears local automation state and the current cookie session.

request.description: Run last. Postman sends the latest login's refresh cookie; the server revokes that session and expires the cookie. On success, scripts clear all locally saved role/active tokens and googleLinkAccessToken. Other sessions are not revoked server-side and already-issued access tokens retain their normal expiry. Failure preserves local state so logout can be retried.
